market.why: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite both concluded lower on August 14, influenced by broader concerns about "America's solvency" and a reported "major correction in the sector" for AI stocks. Heightened geopolitical tensions following the expiration of a US-Iran ceasefire and reduced shipping traffic in the Strait of Hormuz also contributed to investor caution.

yield_10y.why: The 10-year Treasury yield rose to 4.7% as of August 14, potentially driven by escalating US-Iran tensions, which have led to a decline in shipping activity in the Strait of Hormuz, and general worries regarding "America's solvency."

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_calendar.label: Utah Truth in Taxation hearings — expected during August
policy_calendar.note: A Utah taxing entity that wants more property tax revenue than the certified rate allows must hold a public hearing, and those hearings are held in August. The county's Notice of Property Valuation and Tax Changes, mailed in July, carries the actual date and place for a given parcel.

tech.summary: Anthropic announced plans to apply invisible watermarks to text generated by its Claude AI, utilizing Google DeepMind's SynthID-Text technology, to comply with Europe's AI transparency regulations.
OpenAI has reportedly disbanded its preparedness team, which was previously tasked with assessing and mitigating serious risks posed by AI models.
Stripe is reportedly in the process of acquiring OpenRouter, an AI gateway startup, in a deal valued at over $7 billion.

world.summary: US President Donald Trump ordered the scaling back of joint military exercises with South Korea, stating he has a "very good relationship" with North Korean leader Kim Jong-un.
US envoy Jared Kushner met with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in Jerusalem to advance a Gaza peace plan, following prior discussions with Hamas.
Ukrainian strikes have reportedly killed six people and injured four others, including a 14-year-old child, in Russia's Belgorod region, according to the acting governor.
